ammonia.reason: Limited amino acid deamination in low-moisture rennet curd with no surface flora.

animal_barnyard.reason: Tyrosine/tryptophan catabolism to p-cresol ~200 ppb and skatole 1-5 ug/kg in farmhouse aged types.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic chymosin/plasmin peptides from beta-casein, mostly trimmed by lactobacilli peptidases by 12 mo.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium; methyl ketones minimal 2-heptanone 8.6 ug/kg, 2-nonanone 2.9 ug/kg.

browning.reason: Residual galactose/lactose plus lysine Maillard on heating pressed cheddared curd.

buttery.reason: Lactococcus lactis citrate metabolism to diacetyl 4.9 mg/kg and acetoin 1-3 mg/kg.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Lipolysis and lactobacilli esterases: butanoic 22842 ug/kg, hexanoic 3430 ug/kg, isovaleric 126 ug/kg.

creaminess.reason: 34% fat in firm low-moisture matrix limits oral coating despite fat coalescence.

crumbliness.reason: Low MNFS, 12-mo proteolysis and calcium lactate crystals cause fracture.

firmness.reason: Cooked, cheddared and pressed curd at 36.6% moisture with calcium-phosphate crosslinks.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylalanine catabolism to phenylacetaldehyde 96 ug/kg and phenylethanol 58 ug/kg.

fruity.reason: Ethanol-acid esterification to ethyl butanoate 940 ug/kg, ethyl hexanoate 24 ug/kg plus delta-lactones.

goaty.reason: Cow milk without branched 4-methyl/4-ethyloctanoic acids; only straight C6-C8 faint sharpness.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker leucine/isoleucine/phenylalanine to methylbutanals, phenylacetaldehyde and methional 814 ug/kg.

melt.reason: Rennet pH ~5.0 para-casein network flows on heating with moderate fat coalescence.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Linoleate oxidation minimal: 1-octen-3-ol ND-52 ug/kg, 1-octen-3-one 5.3 ug/kg.

oil_off.reason: 34% fat coalesced pools and lipolyzed free fatty acids release free oil on melting.

smoky.reason: No wood smoking; guaiacol/syringol phenols absent in unsmoked Cheddar.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactococcus fermentation acetic acid 15106 ug/kg and cheddaring acidification to pH ~4.95-5.2.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading; cheddaring only mats curd without aligned fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methionine catabolism by lactobacilli to MeSH/DMS and DMTS 21.5 ug/kg plus methional 814 ug/kg.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted at cheddaring; faint sweet from glycerol and delta-decalactone 25 ug/kg.

umami.reason: 12-mo chymosin/plasmin plus Lactococcus peptidase proteolysis to glutamate and savory peptides.
